2609.24760.title: Construting Reverse Thinking: Developing Large Language Models' Reverse Thingking Ability
2609.24760.paper_summary: When facing complex problems, humans tend to try various ideas for different issues. Human thinking patterns exhibit remarkable flexibility in adapting to diverse scenarios. GPT-o1, GPT-o3, and DeepSeek-R1 adopt long chain-of-thought models to address complex problems by increasing reasoning depth, which default to a forward reasoning mode. We conducted statistical analysis on the accuracy of different mathematical problem datasets on models of different scales, and found five reasons for errors: Insufficient solution-space coverage, Computational mistakes, Unverified assumptions, Ignoring constraint conditions, Maximum response length limitation. To address the above issues, we proposed a backward reasoning pattern construction method aimed at enhancing the model's reverse thinking ability and dynamic adaptability. First, we constructed an easy-hard two-stage Math dataset for training large models and gradually improving their inference ability at different difficulty levels. The dataset contains forward reasoning paths as well as backward reasoning paths. And a two-stage supervised fine-tuning process is applied to progressively train the model's backward reasoning capability. Furthermore, a fine-grained reward mechanism is developed, employing smoothed reward signals to strengthen the model's ability to autonomously select thinking modes during the reasoning process, thereby avoiding reward hacking. A linear-decay balanced sampling strategy is designed to maintain a balance between forward and backward reasoning path samples during training, enabling the model to converge quickly and stably. Experimental results show that our method significantly improves reasoning efficiency and accuracy in tasks such as mathematical proofs, offering a flexible and efficient reasoning paradigm for solving complex problems.
2609.24760.paper_summary_zh: 當面對複雜問題時，人類傾向於對不同的問題嘗試各種想法。人類的思維模式在適應多樣情境方面展現出顯著的靈活性。GPT-o1、GPT-o3 和 DeepSeek-R1 採用長鏈思考模型來解決複雜問題，通過增加推理深度，默認使用前向推理模式。我們對不同規模模型在不同數學問題數據集上的準確性進行了統計分析，並找出了五個錯誤原因：解決方案空間覆蓋不足、計算錯誤、未經驗證的假設、忽略約束條件、最大響應長度限制。為了解決上述問題，我們提出了一種後向推理模式構建方法，旨在增強模型的逆向思維能力和動態適應性。首先，我們構建了一個簡單-困難的兩階段數學數據集，用於訓練大型模型，並逐步提高它們在不同難度水平上的推理能力。該數據集包含前向推理路徑以及後向推理路徑。此外，還應用了一個兩階段的監督微調過程，以逐步訓練模型的後向推理能力。此外，開發了一個細粒度的獎勵機制，利用平滑的獎勵信號來加強模型在推理過程中自主選擇思維模式的能力，從而避免獎勵操縱。設計了一種線性衰減平衡抽樣策略，以在訓練過程中保持前向和後向推理路徑樣本之間的平衡，使模型能夠快速而穩定地收斂。實驗結果表明，我們的方法顯著提高了數學證明等任務的推理效率和準確性，為解決複雜問題提供了一種靈活且高效的推理範式。
